public_rationale: On September 29, 2026, Zitron wrote that Anthropic had $4.6 billion in revenue in 2025, citing figures from its S-1. The S-1, filed on October 26, 2026, reports revenue of $4,585 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, in audited statements prepared under U.S. GAAP. That is $4.585 billion, which rounds to $4.6 billion.
limitations: Zitron's source was a Reuters report on a leaked draft. The record checks his figure against the S-1 as filed.
This record assesses reported 2025 revenue only. It does not assess run-rate figures for 2025 or any 2026 period.
